comment.text: Error text in the BuyPlanPanel that appears when funds are inadequate for a purchase, displaying the current balance via the {{amount}} variable.

usage.context:
<Text
 fontSize="13px"
 fontWeight={400}
 className={styles.errorText}
 >
 {t("DocsConnect:WalletInsufficient", {
 amount: formatCurrency(availableCredits),
 })}
 </Text>
 ) : (
 <Text fontSize="13px" className={styles.secondaryText}>
